summary.text: Alonzo Washington is a Democratic Maryland state senator from District 22 who was appointed to the seat in January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served in the Maryland House of Delegates from 2012 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Alonzo Washington was born in Washington, D.C., on September 2, 1983, and graduated from Laurel High School.
He earned a B.A. in criminal justice and criminology from the University of Maryland, College Park, in 2007.

Washington worked as a paralegal at the U.S. Conference of Catholic Bishops in 2007, then as outreach coordinator for the Prince George's County Council from 2008 to 2010 and as the council's chief of staff in 2009.
Washington represented District 22 in the Maryland House of Delegates from 2012 until 2023.
Gov. Wes Moore appointed him to the state Senate on January 27, 2023, to replace Paul Pinsky, and he assumed office on January 30, 2023.
According to the General Assembly website, he serves on the Finance Committee.
